facts.text: Through the e-Warrior Digital Life and Learning Program, Winona State equips participating students and employees with a configured laptop computer, software, and tech support.

sources.title: Article - Getting Ready For Your New ... - Winona State University
sources.quote: the e-Warrior Digital Life and Learning Program provides a fully configured laptop computer, software, continuous network access, technical support, and numerous learning opportunities to all participating WSU students and employees.
